subject: Minute-level headroom request — launch week
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika@clearwave.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Praveen Kumar <praveen@clearwave.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Minute-level headroom request — launch week

Sean —

Quick context: we're pushing a soft launch for the ClearWave search beta on Monday and anticipate short spikes of inference traffic when we open invites. We currently have a hard quota that would throttle the live test flows. Can Redwood authorize a short, minute-level headroom increase (≈4–6x normal qps for a 72-hour window) and provide a one-time concession on the overrun rate?

We expect the total overrun to be ~1.2M tokens over the window; procurement will need a clear invoice path and PO timing. If we can get a temporary uplift with a capped blended rate, we can avoid an hour-by-hour escalation.

Key asks:
- Short-term headroom (72 hours) starting Sunday 10/25 00:00 PT
- Blended overrun rate cap for that window (we're hoping for a discount off public overrun)
- Confirmation of invoicing timing and required PO fields

Thanks — this has a pretty high impact on our beta.

—Anika
Anika Shah
Product Lead, ClearWave

[Attachment: launch-readiness-checklist.pdf (stated)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika@clearwave.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Minute-level headroom request — launch week

Anika —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the beta. Short answer: we can provide a temporary uplift but there are a few commercial and operational pieces to lock down. Proposed approach below so procurement and engineering can move in parallel.

1) Operational uplift
   - Temporary headroom: 4x baseline qps for a 72-hour window starting 2026-10-25 00:00 PT
   - Hard cap: if consumption exceeds X tokens/hour beyond the 4x uplift, we will throttle and notify (we'll share X after engineering confirms final baseline).

2) Commercial concession (one-time)
   - Offer: a one-time blended overrun cap of 0.035 USD/token for the 72-hour window (this is a concession off standard overrun pricing).
   - Minimum commitment: ClearWave agrees to a post-window true-up and signs a short amendment covering the uplift and blended cap.

3) Invoicing & PO
   - We can invoice the overrun on the next monthly invoice (Nov cycle). Procurement should include a PO referencing deal RW-CLW-2741 and line item "Minute headroom — Oct 25–28, 2026".
   - Required PO fields: legal entity name, billing address, PO number, and contact for remittance.

Next steps I suggest:
- If that sounds acceptable, Jordan will send a short amendment and rate sheet (attached). Laura will confirm invoicing expectations. Markus will ensure legal is looped for a fast sign.

I'm attaching a draft rate sheet and a short written proposal. Happy to stand up a 20-min call with engineering if they want to validate the exact cap numbers.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0189

[Attachments: rw_rate_sheet_oct2026.xlsx (pricing table), clearwave_minute_headroom_proposal_v3.pdf (proposal)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika@clearwave.io>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Minute-level headroom request — launch week

Anika —

One operationally simpler alternative that might help procurement: we can set a temporary blended bucket (pre-authorized token pool) for the 72-hour window that ClearWave draws from. If the pool is exhausted we revert to the baseline rate (no immediate throttling) and we reconcile usage post-window. This avoids minute-level throttle flip-flops.

Commercially we can price the pool at the same blended cap Sean proposed (0.035 USD/token) and size it to the 1.2M tokens you quoted. If you prefer this approach, procurement can issue a PO for the pool amount and we will reserve capacity for the window.

Happy to detail the pool sizing on a quick call.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Thanks Sean/Jordan — this is helpful. A couple follow-ups from procurement/security:

- Procurement wants the invoice to show a single line for the "minute headroom pool" with the PO against deal RW-CLW-2741. They need early visibility on the amount so they can route the PO before Friday.
- Legal asked whether this temporary uplift requires any change to our existing Master Agreement (we prefer a one-page amendment if possible).
- Security asked for confirmation that logs and KV cache will be segregated for the window (we do not plan to send PII but want auditing to show separation).

Can you confirm the pool amount and send the one-page amendment template? If you can get PO guidance today we can expedite approvals.

Thanks —
Praveen Kumar

Praveen / Anika —

We can accept a PO today for the pre-authorized token pool. To help procurement size the PO, here's the quick math based on Jordan/Sean's proposed blended cap:

- Proposed pool: 1.2M tokens × 0.035 USD/token = 42,000 USD (this will reserve the capacity for Oct 25–28).
- If you want a 20% safety buffer we suggest PO = 50,400 USD.

Invoice path: we will apply the pool against usage for the window and issue a single invoice line in the November billing cycle referencing PO # and RW-CLW-2741. If the pool is not fully consumed, remaining funds will be applied as a credit to the next invoice or refunded per the amendment.

Legal amendment: Markus — attached is a one-page amendment template that covers the uplift, blended rate cap, and credit rules. If ClearWave signs, we will treat this as an addendum to the existing Master Agreement and no other contract changes are required.

Please confirm PO amount and billing contact (email to send invoice to) and we'll queue this for the finance/payment team.

Thanks,
